clusters.name: Bea's birth, 1995–1996
clusters.reason: Around Bea's birth in March 1995, within the following year: your mother worn out and on edge with the baby by August, your parents working late and rarely home together by November, you developing stomach aches and missing school by February 1996, your brother Jonah shouting matches with your father in May, and your mother not returning to her job by September. The shifts pile up across the household as the new baby arrives.
